description: This file defines an abstract controller class for the OrangeHRM Core Plugin, providing common functionalities for handling HTTP responses, including response retrieval, setting, and handling bad requests.

classes.name: AbstractController
classes.description: An abstract base class for controllers within the OrangeHRM Core plugin, encapsulating common response handling logic.

methods.name: getNewResponse
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Response object.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Retrieves the current response object, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Sets the response object, with type validation to accept only Response, RedirectResponse, or null.

methods.name: handleBadRequest
methods.description: Prepares and returns a Response object indicating a bad request, setting the appropriate HTTP status code.
